value.name: construction work damages bedroom wall
value.description: The construction crew's demolition gets louder as an axe breaks through the wood paneling beside the master suite.
evidence: AN AXE Breaks the beautiful wood panelling in the room next to the master suite.

value.name: Miles begs workers to stop briefly
value.description: Miles urgently asks the workers to wait for a minute, reacting in alarm to the destruction.
evidence: MILES Wait. Just wait for one minute. Sweet Jesus, are you crazy?

value.name: worker reveals he is wielding axe
value.description: The construction worker looks up, revealing that he is the one using the axe, while his co-worker watches.
evidence: CONSTRUCTION WORKER LOOKS UP he's the one wielding the axe.
His co-worker casts a look in our direction.

value.name: Miles retrieves Cohiba cigars from rubble
value.description: Miles reaches into the debris and pulls out a box of Cohiba Especials.
evidence: MILES reaches under the rubble and removes one box of Cohiba Especials.

value.name: worker apologizes for leaving cigars
value.description: The construction worker apologizes to Mr. Massey for not clearing the cigars out earlier.
evidence: CONSTRUCTION WORKER Sorry, Mr. Massey. Thought you cleared that shit out.

value.name: worker warns cigars are harmful
value.description: The worker tells Miles that the cigars can kill him and jokes about old boomer potheads liking them.
evidence: You know, man... those things'll kill ya.
I know all you old boomer potheads like em.

value.name: worker notes cigars are illegal tobacco
value.description: The worker points out that the cigars are illegal pre-Castro imports sold in fancy boxes but still just tobacco.
evidence: They're illegal, and you get to put em in fancy boxes -- but -- shit man! It's still tobacco.
